original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Construct reverse-record two-tape parking with a strictly smaller complete valid-packet tariff.
scope_change_reason: The donor requests original work rather than an audit. The selected baseline passed; a self-posed physical-interface construction replaces the portability task.
bottleneck_link: Side result for precision_tape and owned_erasure: reduce a matched-packet parking subbill while retaining arbitrary ancestor data and complete head/record return. No selected assumption is discharged.
stop_rule: Ship the first proved controller improvement; do not optimize beyond its exact complete tariff.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-size invariants. The standalone verifier enumerates 2047 packets, 21 translated cases and five nesting depths, compares two interpreters and exact charges, and checks 13 rejection/mutation/scope controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can a source-bound caller adopt reversed whole-packet records and realize the complete parking subbill reduction?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A proven local controller saving only affects an actual caller after its representation and full port bill agree.
open_questions.first_step: Identify every direct reader of the forward record format and one matched park/return path, then price the substitution including port production and consumption.
open_questions.blocked_by: No actual caller substitution, live-format migration or optional malformed-port preflight has been priced.
